items.title_en: Putting Linux on my RTX Spark laptop because I don't have a Microsoft account
items.title_zh: 没有微软账户就把 RTX Spark 笔记本装上 Linux
items.summary_en: Linux on the RTX Spark laptop is used to avoid Microsoft account requirements. The post recounts the installation, hardware compatibility, and day-to-day usability, illustrating Linux viability on niche hardware and privacy benefits of not signing into Windows.
items.summary_zh: 在 RTX Spark 笔记本上安装 Linux，以绕开微软账户的限制。文中描述了安装过程、硬件兼容性与日常使用体验，凸显在这类硬件上的 Linux 可行性以及避免 Windows 登录带来的隐私与控制优势。

items.title_en: I no longer care to work on any Ruby gems so I've archived all my repositories
items.title_zh: 我不再维护 Ruby gem，全部仓库已归档
items.summary_en: A developer announces archiving all Ruby gem repositories, effectively stepping back from maintenance. The move highlights open-source maintenance burnout and the fragility of ecosystems when maintainers disengage.
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者宣布将归档所有 Ruby gem 仓库，等于退出维护。此举凸显开源维护的倦怠问题，以及在维护者退出时生态系统的脆弱性。

items.title_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
items.title_zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 发布
items.summary_en: MiniMax introduces the M3.1 Flash, a new hardware release likely targeting compact storage modules for embedded and edge devices. It highlights updated specs and practical uses, underscoring the ongoing push for high-performance, small-form-factor storage solutions.
items.summary_zh: MiniMax 推出 M3.1 Flash 新型硬件，面向嵌入式与边缘设备的紧凑存储模块。文中强调更新规格与实际应用，折射出高性能小型存储的持续需求。

items.title_en: Wine ported to OpenBSD
items.title_zh: Wine 已移植到 OpenBSD
items.summary_en: Wine has been ported to OpenBSD, expanding Windows app compatibility on a security-focused OS. While progress improves accessibility for Windows software, users should expect occasional compatibility gaps and performance trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: Wine 已成功移植到 OpenBSD，扩展了在这一注重安全的操作系统上运行 Windows 应用的能力。虽然兼容性在持续改善，但用户仍需预期个别程序可能存在不兼容或性能折中。

items.title_en: The reverts will continue until morale improves
items.title_zh: 回滚将持续，直到士气好转
items.summary_en: A provocative post argues that reverting changes too frequently harms morale, proposing strategies to reduce churn and improve team culture. It offers practical guidance for faster, more stable software delivery.
items.summary_zh: 一篇挑衅性博文认为过于频繁的回滚会损害士气，提出减少迭代摩擦、改善团队文化的策略。提供更快、更稳定的软件交付的实用建议。

items.title_en: CERN and Mistral sign a statement of intent to establish a strategic partnership
items.title_zh: CERN 与 Mistral 签署建立战略伙伴关系的意向书
items.summary_en: CERN and Mistral sign a statement of intent to collaborate on AI for science, aiming to accelerate research with advanced AI models and shared compute resources. The partnership signals how AI could speed up data analysis in physics and related fields.
items.summary_zh: CERN 与 Mistral 签署战略伙伴关系意向书，计划在科学领域共同推动 AI 的应用，通过先进模型与共享计算资源加速研究。此举体现 AI 有望提升物理等学科的数据分析效率。

items.title_en: Mercury 3: Diffusion at scale
items.title_zh: Mercury 3：大规模扩散模型
items.summary_en: Mercury 3 is pitched as a diffusion-based model designed for large-scale generation, emphasizing throughput, efficiency, and scalability. The post outlines architectural considerations and potential AI/creative applications.
items.summary_zh: Mercury 3 是面向大规模生成的扩散模型，强调吞吐、效率与可扩展性。文中介绍了架构要点及潜在的 AI/艺术创作应用。

items.title_en: Android apps running native on macOS
items.title_zh: Android 应用在 macOS 上原生运行
items.summary_en: A project demonstrates running Android apps natively on macOS, potentially removing emulation overhead. If mature, this could blur platform boundaries for developers and users, enabling smoother access to Android ecosystems on Apple Silicon.
items.summary_zh: 一个项目展示在 macOS 上原生运行 Android 应用，或许能消除仿真开销。若成熟，将模糊开发者与用户的跨平台边界，使 Android 生态在 Apple Silicon 上获得更顺畅的体验。

items.title_en: France's Supermarket Fridges Were Vulnerable Online for Months
items.title_zh: 法国超市冷藏柜数月暴露在网上存在漏洞
items.summary_en: Security researchers found that connected fridge units in French supermarkets had misconfigurations or insecure access exposed online for months, enabling potential manipulation of inventory data or remote control. The incident underscores how consumer hardware in retail can be entry points for cyberattacks, and highlights need for better IoT management and firmware hygiene.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员发现法国多家超市的连网冷柜数月暴露在公开网络中，可能被未经授权的访问者远程操控或篡改库存数据。事件暴露零售业物联网设备的安全薄弱点，也凸显加强设备管理、固件更新和网络分段的重要性。

items.title_en: Timestral: Mistral's time-series foundation models
items.title_zh: Timestral：Mistral 的时序基础模型
items.summary_en: Timestral is Mistral's family of time-series foundation models designed for forecasting tasks, enabling scalable analytics on structured data. By specializing in temporal patterns, these models aim to outperform generic LLMs in finance, IoT, and operations.
items.summary_zh: Timestral 是 Mistral 面向时间序列的基础模型家族，专注于预测任务。通过对时间模式的建模，这类模型为金融、物联网与运营数据的分析提供可扩展的 AI 解决方案，可能在某些领域优于通用 LLM。

items.title_en: OpenBSD 8.0 release will have inteldrm/radeondrm/amdgpu drivers from Linux 6.18
items.title_zh: OpenBSD 8.0 将集成 Linux 6.18 的 inteldrm/radeondrm/amdgpu 驱动
items.summary_en: OpenBSD 8.0 will import Linux 6.18 GPU drivers (inteldrm, radeondrm, amdgpu), expanding support for Intel/AMD GPUs. This move improves hardware compatibility and potentially performance on OpenBSD, but raises questions about Linux code dependencies, licensing, and security boundaries.
items.summary_zh: OpenBSD 8.0 将把 Linux 6.18 的 GPU 驱动（inteldrm、radeondrm、amdgpu）引入到自身代码库中，扩大对英特尔/AMD 显卡的支持。这一举措提升了硬件兼容性与潜在性能，但也带来对 Linux 代码依赖、许可证与安全边界的讨论。

items.title_en: Token-maxxing is dead, OpenRouter's token usage plateaus
items.title_zh: Token 最大化已结束，OpenRouter 的代币使用趋于平缓
items.summary_en: OpenRouter reports that attempting to maximize token usage across prompts has reached a plateau, signaling diminishing returns for token-centric optimization. The shift hints at a broader move toward efficiency or value-based cost models in LLM tooling and API ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter 指出在提示中尽量消耗更多代币的策略已达到瓶颈，对代币导向的优化已不再带来显著收益。此举反映在大模型工具生态中，逐步转向更高效的使用和成本模型的趋势。

items.title_en: Linux 7.3
items.title_zh: Linux 7.3 版本发布
items.summary_en: Linux 7.3 continues the ongoing 7.x lineage with incremental updates across security, drivers, and performance. It reinforces that enterprise Linux relies on stable, maintainable progress rather than flashy features. System administrators should test new kernels in staging before upgrading production environments.
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.3 作为 7.x 系列的持续更新，带来在安全、驱动和性能方面的渐进改进。企业级 Linux 依赖的是稳定、可维护的升级，而非浮夸的新特性。系统管理员在升级生产环境前应在测试环境完成兼容性验证。

items.title_en: Alternatives to animal testing are finally taking off
items.title_zh: 替代动物测试正在显著推进
items.summary_en: Advances such as organ-on-a-chip, sophisticated in vitro models, and in silico simulations are accelerating the replacement of animal testing. Regulatory acceptance is growing, reducing reliance on animal data in drug development and safety assessment.
items.summary_zh: 器官芯片、先进体外模型以及计算模拟等技术正在加速替代动物测试的进展。监管认可度提升，药物开发与安全评估中对动物数据的依赖正在下降。

items.title_en: Maybe There Was an Egg Cartel After All
items.title_zh: 也许真的存在蛋价卡特尔
items.summary_en: Politico examines whether egg price volatility points to cartel-like conduct in a staple market.
items.summary_zh: 《政治家》刊文探讨蛋价波动是否暴露出基础食品市场的卡特尔行为。文章分析市场力量与供应动态如何影响价格可负担性，以及监测价格所依赖的数据信号。

items.title_en: I built a drone with only one motor [video]
items.title_zh: 我用单个马达打造了一架无人机
items.summary_en: A maker built a drone with only one motor, a bold design that challenges conventional drone biomechanics. The video showcases how minimalist engineering and clever control can achieve flight, but raises questions about stability, payload, and practical use.
items.summary_zh: 创客用单电机打造了一架无人机，这一极简设计挑战了传统无人机的结构。视频展示了通过巧妙控制实现飞行的可能性，同时引发对稳定性、载荷与实际应用的讨论。

items.title_en: Europe EV sales rose 70.3% in September, 32.6% of market share
items.title_zh: 欧洲电动车销量九月同比增长 70.3%，市场份额 32.6%
items.summary_en: European EV sales surged by 70.3% year-over-year in September, capturing about one-third of the market, signaling momentum in EV adoption and charging infrastructure growth.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲九月电动车销量同比飙升 70.3%，市场份额约 32.6%，显示电动化采用势头强劲并推动充电基础设施发展。

items.title_en: Degraded availability for GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages and Webhooks
items.title_zh: GitHub Actions、Pages 与 Webhooks 服务可用性下降
items.summary_en: GitHub Actions, Pages, and Webhooks experienced degraded availability, disrupting CI/CD pipelines and site deployments. The incident highlights reliance on cloud services and the ripple effects when critical development tooling falters.
items.summary_zh: GitHub Actions、Pages 与 Webhooks 服 务可用性下降，打断持续集成/部署流程和站点部署。事件凸显对云端服务的依赖，以及关键开发工具故障时的连锁影响。

items.title_en: Ukraine carries out aerial drone evacuation of a wounded soldier
items.title_zh: 乌克兰使用无人机空运受伤士兵
items.summary_en: Ukraine uses aerial drones to evacuate a wounded soldier from the frontline, illustrating new realities of drone-enabled medical evacuation in conflict zones.
items.summary_zh: 乌克兰在前线利用无人机进行受伤士兵的空运撤离，展示了冲突区域中无人机辅助医疗转运的新现实。

items.title_en: Ask HN: How to deal with shipping AI-written code you don't understand?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：如何处理你不完全理解的 AI 生成代码？
items.summary_en: Ask HN thread on handling AI-written code when you don’t fully understand it, covering risk assessment, documentation, and governance practices.
items.summary_zh: 关于在不了解 AI 生成代码细节时如何处理的讨论，涵盖风险评估、文档与治理实践。

items.title_en: Let's Encrypt is adding two additional remote perspectives for domain validation
items.title_zh: Let's Encrypt 为域名验证增加两种远程验证视角
items.summary_en: Let's Encrypt plans to add two additional remote perspectives for domain validation to improve robustness and accessibility. The move aims to diversify validation pathways, reduce reliance on a single validation method, and help users in constrained networks.
items.summary_zh: Let’s Encrypt 将为域名验证新增两种远程验证视角，以提升鲁棒性与可访问性。此举旨在丰富验证路径，降低对单一验证方式的依赖，并帮助在受限网络环境中完成验证。

items.title_en: One Hash Bloom Filters
items.title_zh: 单哈希布隆过滤器
items.summary_en: An exploration of a Bloom filter variant that uses a single hash function, reducing memory and computation while preserving useful false-positive rates.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章提出一种只需单一哈希函数即可实现的布隆过滤器变体，进一步降低内存和计算开销，同时保持可控的误报率。适用于资源受限的系统中高效的集合成员资格检测，并讨论了权衡与应用场景。

items.title_en: Ontology-Driven Observability: Building an End-to-End Knowledge Graph at Netflix
items.title_zh: 本体驱动的可观测性： Netflix 的端到端知识图谱
items.summary_en: Netflix's ontology-driven observability uses a knowledge graph to unify telemetry across services, enabling end-to-end instrumentation and insights at scale.
items.summary_zh: Netflix 的本体驱动可观测性通过知识图谱统一跨服务的遥测数据，实现大规模的端到端可观测性与洞察。

items.title_en: Plex vulnerabilities being exploited in the wild to drop a cryptominer
items.title_zh: Plex 漏洞在现实环境中被利用来部署矿工
items.summary_en: Plex vulnerabilities are being exploited in the wild to drop a cryptominer, highlighting active threat activity in consumer media server software and the need to patch promptly.
items.summary_zh: Plex 漏洞在实际环境中被利用以部署加密货币矿工，凸显消费者媒体服务器软件的实时威胁活动与及时打补丁的必要性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Qwen3-4B with the AI writing tics trained out
items.title_zh: Show HN：Qwen3-4B 去除写作口癖的版本
items.summary_en: Show HN showcases a Qwen3-4B variant trained to suppress common AI writing tics, resulting in more natural, readable output. It demonstrates progress toward less artificial-sounding generation and may influence model evaluation.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了对 Qwen3-4B 的变体，训练目标是抑制常见的 AI 写作口癖，从而产出更自然、易读的文本。表明了让生成更具自然感的进展，并可能影响对模型的评估。

items.title_en: Documents: Police officer gave her Flock login to her ICE agent husband
items.title_zh: 文件披露：警官将 Flock 登录凭据交给她的 ICE 代理丈夫
items.summary_en: A Savannah police officer allegedly shared her Flock login with her husband, who works as an ICE agent. The breach underscores how easy-to-share credentials can expose sensitive investigative data and trigger internal security reviews. It highlights the need for strict access controls and auditing in sensitive apps.
items.summary_zh: 一名萨凡纳警官据称将 Flock 登录凭据交给她的 ICE 代理丈夫。此举暴露了敏感调查数据的访问风险，并可能引发内部安全审查。事件凸显对敏感应用实施严格访问控制与审计的必要性。

items.title_en: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
items.title_zh: 混合推理代理：在潜在空间思考、通过文本执行行动的 LLM 代理
items.summary_en: Researchers propose Hybrid Reasoning Agents that operate by thinking in a latent space while taking actions via text. The approach blends neural representations with text-based control to enable scalable, interpretable planning in complex tasks.
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出混合推理代理，其在潜在空间中进行推理，并通过文本执行行动。这种方法将神经表示与文本控制结合，提升在复杂任务中的可扩展性与可解释性。

items.title_en: Ukraine claims first drone evacuation of wounded soldier
items.title_zh: 乌克兰宣布首次用无人机从前线撤离受伤士兵
items.summary_en: Ukraine reports the first drone-assisted evacuation of a wounded soldier from the front lines, signaling a potential new use case for unmanned aircraft in casualty extraction under combat conditions. While not replacing medevac helicopters, it could speed triage, reduce risk to human responders, and influence battlefield logistics and tech procurement.
items.summary_zh: 乌克兰声称在前线首次实现受伤士兵的无人机撤离，标志着无人机在战场救援中的新应用。该做法并非取代直升机医撤，但可能加速分级救治、降低人类救援人员暴露风险，并影响未来的战场后勤与相关技术采购。

items.title_en: Namecheap just seized and disabled all my domains
items.title_zh: Namecheap 竟然没收并禁用我所有的域名
items.summary_en: A user claims Namecheap seized and disabled all domains, raising questions about registrar control, ownership, and due process.
items.summary_zh: 用户称 Namecheap 竟然没收并禁用了他所有的域名，暴露了注册商对域名控制、所有权与流程的潜在风险。

items.title_en: The obscure trust looming over Anthropic's IPO
items.title_zh: 笼罩 Anthropic 首次公开募股的隐秘信托
items.summary_en: The article exposes a little-known trust that could influence Anthropic's IPO, touching on ownership, tax, and governance implications. Understanding this structure helps explain how AI startups navigate going public and investor expectations.
items.summary_zh: 报道揭示了一个鲜为人知的信托，可能影响 Anthropic 的首次公开募股及其相关的所有权、税务与治理影响。理解这一结构有助于解释 AI 初创公司如何应对上市与投资者期望。

items.title_en: Someone behind the software
items.title_zh: 软件背后的人
items.summary_en: It argues that progress in tech depends as much on people and processes as on algorithms or architectures.
items.summary_zh: 文本聚焦于塑造软件的人员与组织因素，强调工具选择、团队激励等比代码更能决定成败。它认为科技进步在很大程度上取决于人和流程，而不仅仅是算法或架构。

items.title_en: Starcraft: Ashfall
items.title_zh: 星际争霸：Ashfall
items.summary_en: A new StarCraft shooter titled Ashfall promises a cross-genre experience, blending RTS roots with shooter mechanics. Early previews and development chatter point to innovative creature design and competitive modes that could energize the franchise.
items.summary_zh: 一款名为 Ashfall 的星际争霸衍生射击游戏正在开发，尝试在经典 RTS 上引入射击玩法。初步预览与开发讨论显示出独特的生物设计和竞争模式，或将为系列注入新活力。

items.title_en: William Gibson and the trademarking of cyberspace
items.title_zh: 威廉·吉布森与网络空间的商标化
items.summary_en: William Gibson coined cyberspace in his cyberpunk fiction, helping define a cultural concept that later became a marketable asset. The article traces how the term migrated from literary prose to trademarked real estate, shaping IP strategy and branding in tech and policy. It highlights the friction between imaginative language and legal ownership in the digital era.
items.summary_zh: 威廉·吉布森在科幻作品中首次提出“网络空间”这一概念，塑造了一个后来成为品牌资产的文化术语。文章追溯这一术语如何从文学创作转变为可注册商标，影响科技公司在品牌与法务上的策略。揭示了想象语言与数字时代法律产权之间的张力。

items.title_en: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know whats going on?
items.title_zh: 如果你不运行自己的 LLM 代理，你如何知道发生了什么？
items.summary_en: Relying on hosted LLM APIs hides the model's behavior and data flows; running your own proxy gives visibility into prompts, responses, and potential data leakage. It enables you to enforce policies, audit usage, and protect privacy, especially in regulated or sensitive environments. The piece argues that governance starts with visibility into the model's operations.
items.summary_zh: 依赖云端 LLM API 让你看不到模型内部的行为和数据流动。自行搭建代理可让你监控输入输出、发现数据泄露风险，并执行策略与合规审查，尤其在受监管或敏感场景中尤为重要。

items.title_en: DeepSeek search and fetch – $0.75 per 1000 successful requests
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 搜索与获取服务：每千次请求 0.75 美元
items.summary_en: DeepSeek launches a 'search and fetch' API priced at $0.75 per 1000 successful requests. This pricing positions the service as a cost-efficient option for building search-heavy apps and data pipelines, potentially enabling more frequent queries at scale. It could shake up budget planning for developers who rely on external search endpoints.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 推出名为 'search and fetch' 的 API，按每成功请求 1000 次收取 0.75 美元。该定价面向需要大量检索的应用，提供更具成本效益的查询方案，可能改变开发者在数据检索与管线中的预算和架构选择。

items.title_en: Introducing Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models
items.title_zh: 推出 Clairic：System One 体系的新型提取模型
items.summary_en: Cloudflare introduces Clairic, a new System One class of extraction models designed to extract structured information efficiently. The launch highlights improvements in precision and privacy-conscious design, with safeguards against leakage in extraction workflows.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 发布 Clairic，属于 System One 体系的新型提取模型族，聚焦于高效从数据中提取结构化信息。该系列强调在提取任务中的精度与隐私保护，并为防止信息泄露提供了相关设计思路。

items.title_en: RepRapMicron
items.title_zh: RepRapMicron：开放源代码的微型3D打印平台
items.summary_en: RepRapMicron documents an open-source micro-scale motion platform for RepRap-style 3D systems, emphasizing sub-micrometer precision. The project offers mechanical designs, electronics, and firmware to enable precision micro-manufacturing at a hobbyist level. It showcases how open hardware can democratize advanced fabrication capabilities.
items.summary_zh: RepRapMicron 记录了一个用于 RepRap 系列的微型尺度运动平台，强调亚纳米级（亚微米）精度。该项目提供机械设计、电子和固件，面向爱好者层面的微型制造。它展示了开源硬件如何让高端加工能力走向大众。

items.title_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Max)
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017（Max）
items.summary_en: DeepSeek v4.1 introduces the Flash 1017 (Max) update, signaling a performance and feature refresh.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek v4.1 引入 Flash 1017（Max）更新，标志着性能与功能的提升。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Laminar (YC S24) – RL-trained model that finds errors in agent traces
items.title_zh: 推出 HN：Laminar（YC S24）— 强化学习训练的模型用于发现代理轨迹中的错误
items.summary_en: Laminar, a RL-trained model from YC S24, identifies errors in agent traces, enabling faster debugging of RL systems. It helps reduce manual inspection and improve reliability, though it raises questions about training data quality and coverage.
items.summary_zh: Laminar 是 YC S24 的强化学习训练模型，能够在代理轨迹中发现错误。该工具有望加速 RL 系统的调试、减少人工检查，但也带来关于训练数据质量与覆盖范围的考虑。

items.title_en: Show HN: KiviDB, a faster Redis-compatible memory database and vector cache
items.title_zh: KiviDB，一种更快的 Redis 兼容内存数据库与向量缓存
items.summary_en: KiviDB positions as a faster Redis-compatible in-memory database with vector caching, targeting real-time analytics and AI workloads that demand low latency.
items.summary_zh: KiviDB 被定位为更快的 Redis 兼容内存数据库，提供向量缓存，面向对延迟要求极高的实时分析与 AI 工作负载。

items.title_en: Tmux and Claude Code: Sessions, Send-Keys, and the Ceiling
items.title_zh: Tmux 与 Claude Code：会话管理、发送按键与瓶颈
items.summary_en: Using tmux to host Claude Code sessions enables managing AI-assisted coding workflows inside terminal multiplexed environments. The guide covers sessions, sending keys, and practical limits, highlighting throughput and latency bottlenecks.
items.summary_zh: 在 tmux 会话中运行 Claude Code，可将 AI 辅助的编码工作流整合进终端多路复用环境。文章介绍如何管理会话、发送按键，以及当前的吞吐与延迟瓶颈。

items.title_en: The End of Rationing
items.title_zh: 配给制度的终结
items.summary_en: The piece argues that with rising efficiency in supply chains, AI, and market mechanisms, traditional rationing is becoming obsolete or less needed. It discusses implications for policy, pricing, and user access to scarce resources.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为随着供应链效率、市场机制和技术进步，传统的配给制度正在变得不再必要或常态化。提出对政策、定价和资源获取的影响与思考。

items.title_en: ESA's Hera Will View Asteroid Scars from DART's Strike
items.title_zh: ESA 的 Hera 将观测 DART 碰撞后的小行星伤痕
items.summary_en: ESA's Hera mission will rendezvous with the Didymos system to image and measure the crater created by NASA's DART impact. The data will validate impact models and help calibrate planetary-defense techniques for future mitigation strategies.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲航天局的 Hera 任务将与双小行星系统会合，拍摄并测量 DART 碰撞形成的陨坑。数据有助于校验碰撞模型、校准行星防御策略。

items.title_en: Towards Company World Models
items.title_zh: 迈向企业世界模型
items.summary_en: Towards Company World Models discusses using AI-driven knowledge representations to model workflows, processes, and knowledge across an organization, enabling better planning and decision-making.
items.summary_zh: 《迈向企业世界模型》探讨利用 AI 驱动的知识表示来建模企业中的工作流、流程与知识，提升规划与决策能力。

items.title_en: macOS 15.8.2 Breaks OpenGL
items.title_zh: macOS 15.8.2 将 OpenGL 支持破坏
items.summary_en: macOS 15.8.2 breaks OpenGL support, causing rendering issues for apps that still rely on legacy GL contexts. Apple has deprecated OpenGL in recent updates, pushing developers toward Metal. The change underscores the risk of relying on deprecated APIs for future OS releases.
items.summary_zh: macOS 15.8.2 破坏了 OpenGL 支持，导致仍依赖旧版 GL 上下文的应用出现渲染问题。苹果已在更新中淡化 OpenGL，推崇 Metal，强调了依赖已弃用 API 的风险。

items.title_en: There's never been a better time to go into math (by: 3blue1brown) [video]
items.title_zh: 现在是进入数学领域的最佳时机（3blue1brown 视频）
items.summary_en: 3Blue1Brown argues that this is an ideal moment to study math, highlighting accessible resources, visual intuition, and the excitement of discovery that modern tools unlock. The video frames math as a living, creative pursuit powered by these tools.
items.summary_zh: 3Blue1Brown 认为现在学习数学是最好的时机，强调可获取的资源、直观的可视化和新工具在现代环境中带来的发现乐趣。视频将数学呈现为由这些工具驱动的充满创造性的现实探索。

items.title_en: Agentic Monitoring
items.title_zh: 具代理性的监控
items.summary_en: A thought-provoking piece arguing that monitoring systems should be agentic — capable of taking initiative, not just reporting signals. It discusses design, control, and safety implications for AI governance and autonomous systems.
items.summary_zh: 这篇博文提出监控系统应具备代理性，能够主动采取行动，而不仅是被动汇报。文章讨论了在 AI 治理和自治系统中的设计、控制与安全含义。

items.title_en: Show HN: I built a task system to handle the drudgery so I could focus on tasks
items.title_zh: Show HN：为把繁琐工作自动化而构建的任务系统
items.summary_en: Show HN showcases a task system built to handle drudgery, freeing the author to focus on higher-value tasks and demonstrating pragmatic product design.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示一个用于自动化繁琐工作的任务系统，帮助作者专注于更高价值的任务，体现务实的产品设计。

items.title_en: Maxwell: A new kind of model that sits between code and hardware
items.title_zh: Maxwell：介于代码与硬件之间的新型模型
items.summary_en: Maxwell presents a model that sits between code and hardware, suggesting new ways for software to reason about hardware constraints and performance. It hints at deeper integration of AI with devices.
items.summary_zh: Maxwell 提出一种介于代码与硬件之间的新型模型，暗示软件在推理时会考虑硬件约束与性能，预示 AI 与设备的更深度整合。

items.title_en: Florida's HOAs and condo associations are making the housing crisis worse
items.title_zh: 佛罗里达州的 HOA 与公寓协会正在加剧住房危机
items.summary_en: Florida HOAs and condo associations constrain housing supply via rules and fees, worsening the state's housing affordability crisis. The piece argues for policy reforms and smarter, scalable housing development approaches.
items.summary_zh: 佛罗里达州的业主协会和公寓协会通过规则和费用限制住房供应，进一步加剧了该州的可负担性危机。文章主张进行政策改革与更高效、可扩展的住房开发。

items.title_en: Free Pascal compiler now supports dynamic packages
items.title_zh: Free Pascal 编译器现已支持动态包
items.summary_en: The Free Pascal compiler now supports dynamic packages, enabling runtime-loading of modular components and plugins. This makes it easier to distribute extensible Pascal apps and reduces binary bloat by loading code on demand, aligning with Lazarus/LF project workflows.
items.summary_zh: Free Pascal 编译器现已支持动态包，允许在运行时加载模块和插件，提升可扩展性并降低初始二进制体积。此举与 Lazarus、跨平台 Pascal 应用的生态更紧密结合。

items.title_en: Superlite: A Faster Alternatie to Superpowers
items.title_zh: Superlite：比 Superpowers 更快的替代方案
items.summary_en: Superlite offers a faster alternative to Superpowers.
items.summary_zh: Superlite 提供比 Superpowers 更快的替代方案。

items.title_en: Chicago O'Hare digs up 50-ton boulder under airfield, asks public for name ideas
items.title_zh: 芝加哥奥黑尔机场在跑道下挖出50吨巨石，征求公众起名
items.summary_en: Chicago O'Hare unearthed a 50-ton boulder under the airfield, and is seeking public name ideas, turning a maintenance find into a light-hearted community moment.
items.summary_zh: 芝加哥奥黑尔机场在跑道下挖出50吨巨石，正在征集公众命名，将一次维护发现变成轻松的社区趣事。

items.title_en: It's still ok to enjoy programming
items.title_zh: 仍然可以享受编程
items.summary_en: The piece argues that programming is as much a craft as a skill, emphasizing curiosity, joy, and craftsmanship for sustainable productivity. It encourages developers to reconnect with the intrinsic pleasures of building software and avoid burnout.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张编程不仅是技能，更是一门工艺；强调好奇心、乐趣和匠心对于长期产出的重要性。鼓励开发者重新寻找编程的内在乐趣，避免职业倦怠。

items.title_en: Show HN: The Zelda timeline to catch up before the Ocarina of Time remake
items.title_zh: Show HN：在塞尔达时间线整理前赶上重制版
items.summary_en: Show HN features an interactive Zelda timeline that consolidates official and fan-made lore to help players catch up before the Ocarina of Time remake. It demonstrates how data-driven, browser-friendly tooling can enrich fan engagement and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示一个将官方与粉丝的塞尔达传说时间线整合在一起的互动工具，帮助玩家在《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版到来前赶上剧情。此类数据驱动、浏览器友好工具提升了粉丝参与度与可访问性。

items.title_en: Parser Combinators
items.title_zh: 解析器组合子
items.summary_en: Parser combinators are a functional-programming technique for building parsers by composing small parsing functions. The piece surveys core ideas, common combinators, and practical patterns, offering examples across languages and showing how to get readable, maintainable parsers without writing a monolithic parser.
items.summary_zh: 解析器组合子是通过将小型解析函数组合来构建解析器的函数式编程技术。文中概述了核心思想、常用组合子与实践模式，并给出跨语言示例，展示如何用模块化方式实现可维护的解析器。

items.title_en: Legal experts warn Meta's new terms still grant broad scraping permissions
items.title_zh: 法律专家警告：Meta新条款仍授予广泛抓取权限
items.summary_en: Legal scholars warn that Meta's updated terms continue to grant broad rights to scrape data, despite language changes. The stance could enable large-scale data harvesting, raising concerns for researchers, startups and privacy advocates about how the platform's data can be used.
items.summary_zh: 法律专家警告，尽管措辞有所改动，Meta更新条款仍授权广泛抓取数据。这可能允许大规模数据收集，引发研究者、初创公司和隐私倡导者对平台数据使用的担忧。

items.title_en: Open MicroManipulator – A sub-micrometer 3D motion control plattform
items.title_zh: Open MicroManipulator：亚微米级三维运动控制平台
items.summary_en: Open MicroManipulator is a sub-micrometer 3D motion control platform with open hardware and firmware. The project aims to democratize precision manipulation for research and education, enabling ultra-fine control in labs and makerspaces.
items.summary_zh: Open MicroManipulator 提供一个开源硬件与固件的亚微米级三维运动控制平台，旨在让研究与教育领域的高精度操作民主化，便于实验室和创客空间实现极细微的控制。

items.title_en: Java sealed classes and exhaustive pattern matching
items.title_zh: Java 的密封类与穷尽模式匹配
items.summary_en: The post explains how sealed classes enable exhaustive pattern matching checks at compile time, reducing runtime errors. It also covers best practices for using sealed hierarchies with switch expressions and discusses trade-offs with openness.
items.summary_zh: 文章阐述了密封类如何在编译时实现穷尽模式匹配，降低运行时错误，并提供使用密封层次结构与 switch 表达式的最佳实践，同时讨论了开放性带来的权衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare
items.title_zh: Show HN：WhatsApp MCP 在 Cloudflare 免费运行
items.summary_en: Show HN: A project showing WhatsApp MCP running for free on Cloudflare. Demonstrates edge-friendly deployment of messaging protocol tooling and practical hosting without traditional servers.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：WhatsApp MCP 在 Cloudflare 免费运行，展示了边缘计算环境下对消息协议工具的可部署性，以及无需传统服务器的托管方式。

items.title_en: Footage of the Flock search that a judge ruled was uncosntitutional
items.title_zh: Footage of the Flock search that a judge ruled was unconstitutional
items.summary_en: Footage from a Flock search—an automated license-plate or facial recognition tool—was ruled unconstitutional by a judge, highlighting ongoing civil-liberties concerns around enforcement tech and warrants. The ruling underscores limits on how surveillance tools can be used in policing.
items.summary_zh: 一段关于 Flock 搜索的录像因被法官裁定违宪而曝光，凸显了对公共监控技术在执法中的广泛使用以及隐私与宪法权利的担忧。

items.title_en: Dogs seem to agree with humans that 'bouba' is round and 'kiki' is spiky
items.title_zh: 狗似乎认同人类的圆形-尖刺联想：Bouba/Kiki 实验
items.summary_en: Dogs align with humans on Bouba/Kiki shape-label mappings, suggesting shared perceptual categories across species. The result supports the idea that some cross-species associations are rooted in perceptual priors rather than language.
items.summary_zh: 犬类在 Bouba/Kiki 的形状标签映射上与人类保持一致，表明不同物种可能共享感知类别。研究结果支持某些跨物种联想源自感知先验，而非语言。

items.title_en: PalmOS Lemmings
items.title_zh: Aaron Ardiri 的 PalmOS Lemmings
items.summary_en: Aaron Ardiri has released PalmOS Lemmings, a faithful PalmOS port of the classic puzzle game Lemmings. It highlights retro game preservation and the ongoing hobbyist effort to run vintage software on aging mobile platforms.
items.summary_zh: Aaron Ardiri 发布了 PalmOS Lemmings，这是对经典解谜游戏 Lemmings 的 PalmOS 版本移植，展示了对复古游戏的保护与在老旧移动平台上运行早期软件的热情。

items.title_en: You could have invented transformers from memory
items.title_zh: 你本可以凭记忆发明 Transformer
items.summary_en: The post argues that transformers could have been derived from associative-memory principles and simple design choices, reframing attention as a form of content-addressable recall. That perspective clarifies why transformers generalize well and suggests alternative conceptual paths that might have yielded the architecture earlier.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张可以从联想记忆的原理和若干简单设计中推导出 Transformer，把注意力机制视为一种基于内容的检索。这个视角解释了 Transformer 的良好泛化性，并暗示有其他概念路径可能更早带来相似架构。

items.title_en: Cairn: Open windows into AI-driven cyber operations
items.title_zh: Cairn：AI 驱动的网络行动的开放视图
items.summary_en: Cairn provides windows into AI-driven cyber operations, offering visibility into autonomous cyber tasks and their outcomes, with safety and governance considerations for operators.
items.summary_zh: Cairn 为 AI 驱动的网络行动提供开放视图，帮助观察自主网络任务及其结果，并考虑操作中的安全与治理。

items.title_en: How Quickly Can the DoD Rebuild and Recast the Munitions Industrial Base?
items.title_zh: 国防部多快能重建并重塑军品工业基础？
items.summary_en: CSIS analyzes the timeline and challenges for rebuilding the DoD's munitions industrial base, emphasizing supply-chain resilience, domestic manufacturing, workforce, and policy alignment. It underscores this as a long, multi-year effort requiring sustained investment.
items.summary_zh: CSIS 的分析围绕美国国防部重建与重塑军品工业基地的时间线及挑战，强调供应链韧性、本土制造能力、劳动力和产业政策等关键要素。结论认为这是一项，需要多年投入与政策协调的长期工作。

items.title_en: Verisign .com Domain Name Registry Consumer Class Action
items.title_zh: Verisign .com 域名注册商消费者集体诉讼
items.summary_en: Consumers allege Verisign's management of the .com registry harmed users, possibly around pricing, renewal practices, or security; the action could lead to refunds or changes in terms. If successful, the case could set precedents for how registry operators are regulated and held accountable.
items.summary_zh: 消费者对 Verisign 的 .com 域名注册管理提起集体诉讼，指控在价格、续费策略或安全等方面损害用户利益。案件若获胜，可能带来赔偿和对注册商条款的调整，对域名持有者具有现实影响。

items.title_en: The Annotated VT100 Firmware (2022)
items.title_zh: 注释版 VT100 固件
items.summary_en: The Annotated VT100 Firmware provides a deep dive into the DEC VT100 terminal's ROM and firmware, with annotations that reveal historical hardware design and software patterns. It serves as a valuable resource for retro-computing and embedded systems enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: 注释版 VT100 固件对 DEC VT100 终端的 ROM 与固件进行了详细注释，揭示了早期硬件设计和软件实现的思路。对复古计算与嵌入式系统爱好者具有重要参考价值。

items.title_en: Harness Engineering 101: The LLM is the brain, the harness is the body
items.title_zh: Harness 工程学入门：LLM 是大脑，Harness 是躯体
items.summary_en: Harness engineering separates reasoning from actions by treating the LLM as the brain and the harness as the body that interfaces with tools and environments. This decoupling improves reliability, safety, and testability in AI agents, while illustrating practical design patterns and common pitfalls.
items.summary_zh: Harness 工程学将推理与执行解耦，LLM 担任大脑，harness 则作为与工具和环境交互的躯体。这样的分离提升了 AI 代理的可靠性、安全性和可测试性，同时揭示了实用的设计范式及常见坑点。

items.title_en: The Intel 8087 chip: floating-point addition and subtraction
items.title_zh: 英特尔 8087 浮点加减运算的微码揭秘
items.summary_en: The article dives into the 8087 microcode path for floating-point addition and subtraction, revealing early FP unit design tricks that made real-time math feasible on x86. It connects these traces to the evolution of modern FP performance and architecture.
items.summary_zh: 文章深入分析 8087 浮点加法/减法的微码路径，揭示早期浮点单元设计中的巧妙之处，使得 x86 上的实时浮点运算成为可能，并将这些细节与现代浮点性能及架构的演进联系起来。

items.title_en: I built a programming language that LLMs can't use
items.title_zh: 我设计了一个连 LLM 都用不了的编程语言
items.summary_en: I built a programming language that LLMs can't use, exploring design choices that frustrate model-assisted code generation. The result, Killswitch Lang, highlights challenges in tooling, language features, and safeguards for human-centric programming.
items.summary_zh: 我设计了一个让大型语言模型无法使用的编程语言，探讨了阻碍模型辅助代码生成的设计选择。其成果强调了对编程工具、语言特性以及人为驱动开发的安全性挑战。

items.title_en: Personal software factories are a waste of time
items.title_zh: 个人软件工厂是浪费时间
items.summary_en: A provocative essay argues that building personal software factories—automating personal tooling and code—is inefficient; instead, embrace outsourcing or platform-level tools.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章批评打造个人软件工厂的想法，认为为个人工作流投入时间与资源收益有限。作者建议转向可复用的工具、平台和开源生态以提升长期生产力。

items.title_en: A new way to think about borrow checking (in reverse)
items.title_zh: 从反向视角看借用检查的新思路
items.summary_en: A new take on borrow checking flips the traditional perspective, examining lifetimes by tracing how data flows backward from usage. The approach aims to simplify reasoning about aliasing, mutability, and borrows, potentially easing compiler checks without sacrificing safety. It could influence future language design and verification tools.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章从相反的角度重新思考借用检查，逆向追踪数据的使用路径来分析生命周期。该方法旨在简化对别名、可变性和借用的推理，或在不牺牲安全性的前提下让编译器校验更易于实现，可能影响未来语言设计与验证工具。

items.title_en: RuneScape Bench: MMOs for Agents [video]
items.title_zh: RuneScape 基准测试：面向代理的 MMO [视频]
items.summary_en: RuneScape Bench tests AI agents in MMOs, using the game as a sandbox to study agent behavior and learning in interactive environments. The takeaway is that game worlds remain valuable for benchmarking AI that must reason under uncertainty and real-time constraints.
items.summary_zh: RuneScape 基准测试在 MMO 中评估 AI 代理，将游戏世界作为交互环境的试验场。结论是游戏环境仍然是评估在不确定性与实时约束下推理能力的 AI 的宝贵基准。

items.title_en: The Brain Sandwich
items.title_zh: 大脑三明治
items.summary_en: The Brain Sandwich presents a provocative reflection on cognition and AI, using a brain-as-a-sandwich metaphor to challenge common assumptions about thinking and computation.
items.summary_zh: 《大脑三明治》对认知与 AI 进行挑衅性反思，用“大脑如同三明治”的比喻挑战人们对思维与计算的常见假设。

items.title_en: "I'm on a war footing": Terry Tao and the crisis in math
items.title_zh: “我正处于战争准备状态”：泰勒·陶与数学危机
items.summary_en: Terry Tao argues that the mathematics community faces a crisis driven by AI, complexity, and funding pressures, calling for stronger collaboration and renewed focus on foundational problems.
items.summary_zh: 泰勒·陶指出，受人工智能、研究经费和学科挑战等因素影响，数学界正面临危机。他呼吁加强合作与重新聚焦基础问题，强调 AI 对研究文化与培养年轻数学家的影响。

items.title_en: Teal – A statically-typed dialect of Lua
items.title_zh: Teal：Lua 的静态类型方言
items.summary_en: Teal adds a statically-typed layer to Lua, enabling compile-time checks and better editor tooling while remaining interoperable with existing Lua code. The project promotes optional typing and gradual adoption, helping teams catch errors earlier without abandoning Lua's flexibility.
items.summary_zh: Teal 为 Lua 增添静态类型系统，能够进行编译期检查并提升编辑器支持，同时与现有 Lua 代码保持互操作。该语言强调可选类型与渐进式采用，帮助团队在不牺牲灵活性的前提下更早发现错误。

items.title_en: The fire retardant in the seafood chain
items.title_zh: 海鲜链中的阻燃剂
items.summary_en: The piece investigates ethoxyquin, a fire retardant still used in some seafood supply chains, raising concerns about chemical exposure and safety standards. It highlights regulatory gaps and calls for greater transparency in seafood sourcing.
items.summary_zh: 报道关注海鲜供应链中仍在使用的阻燃剂乙氧基喹，因化学暴露与安全标准引发担忧。指出监管缺口并呼吁提升海鲜采购透明度。

items.title_en: What the heck is /pkg?
items.title_zh: /pkg 是什么？
items.summary_en: What is /pkg? A post explains the role of /pkg directories in packaging ecosystems and how they differ from other paths, clarifying deployment workflows.
items.summary_zh: 什么是 /pkg？文章解释了在打包生态中 /pkg 目录的作用，以及它与其他路径的区别，帮助理清部署工作流中的概念。

items.title_en: Rabbits were a medieval royal luxury in England until the Black Death
items.title_zh: 英国中世纪的皇家奢侈：兔子直至黑死病前都是珍品
items.summary_en: Rabbits were a status symbol for English royalty in the Middle Ages, farmed in elaborate warrens and treated as scarce luxury meat. The Black Death upended aristocratic diets and economies, reshaping what counted as luxury and who could afford it. The piece underscores how pandemics can abruptly shift supply chains and social hierarchies around food.
items.summary_zh: 中世纪时，兔子被英国王室视作高端奢侈品，养在专门的兔养场，供给稀缺且价格昂贵。随着黑死病的爆发，贵族饮食和经济结构遭到重创，奢侈品的地位和获取方式也随之改变。此次发现强调疫情如何迅速打乱食物供应链与社会等级。

items.title_en: Integer to String Conversion (2014)
items.title_zh: 整数转字符串转换（2014）
items.summary_en: A 2014 post delves into integer-to-string conversion, covering correctness pitfalls and performance considerations. It compares methods like itoa, sprintf, and custom fast paths, underscoring how small implementation choices affect reliability.
items.summary_zh: 2014 年的文章深入探讨整数到字符串的转换，覆盖正确性和性能方面的要点。对比了多种实现方式（itoa、sprintf、自定义快速路径），强调细小实现选择对稳健性与效率的影响。

items.title_en: Beyond Tetris: The other games of Alexey Pajitnov [video]
items.title_zh: 超越俄罗斯方块：帕吉特诺夫的其他游戏 [视频]
items.summary_en: Beyond Tetris highlights Pajitnov’s other puzzle games, exploring his broader design influence beyond the iconic title. The video offers context on his design philosophy and legacy.
items.summary_zh: 《超越俄罗斯方块：帕吉特诺夫的其他游戏》聚焦他除《Tetris》之外的谜题游戏，探讨他在更广领域的设计影响。视频提供对其设计理念与遗产的背景解析。

items.title_en: Show HN: Ranet3 – High performance policy routed IPsec mesh SD-WAN
items.title_zh: 高性能策略路由的 IPsec Mesh SD-WAN
items.summary_en: A high-performance design for policy-routed IPsec mesh SD-WAN, addressing latency, throughput, and security trade-offs for distributed networks.
items.summary_zh: 介绍基于策略路由的 IPsec Mesh SD-WAN 的高性能设计，讨论分布式网络中的延迟、吞吐和安全取舍。

items.title_en: Laptop Based on 6502 CPU
items.title_zh: 基于 6502 CPU 的笔记本电脑
items.summary_en: A laptop built around the 6502 CPU showcases retro computing in a portable form, blending classic hardware with modern peripherals. The project highlights how old architectures can still inspire hobbyist hardware, energy-efficient designs, and education about computer fundamentals. It also raises questions about performance, software compatibility, and DIY hardware culture.
items.summary_zh: 这款笔记本以6502处理器为核心，将经典硬件带入便携设备。它展示了复古架构在便携化、低功耗设计和硬件爱好者教育中的潜力，同时也引发关于性能与软件兼容性的讨论。

items.title_en: Gdynia and the Dream of a Maritime Poland
items.title_zh: 格丁尼亚与波兰的海洋梦想
items.summary_en: Gdynia’s rise as a major Baltic port reflects Poland’s postwar modernization and its maritime ambitions. The piece traces urban planning, port governance, and logistics evolution that positioned Gdynia within Europe’s sea-trade network.
items.summary_zh: 格丁尼亚成为波兰波罗的海地区重要港口的崛起，体现战后现代化进程与海洋抱负。文章梳理了城市规划、港口治理与物流体系的演变，以及其在欧洲海上贸易网络中的地位。

items.title_en: The DNS Museum
items.title_zh: DNS 博物馆
items.summary_en: The DNS Museum curates artifacts and explanations tracing the history and evolution of the Domain Name System, highlighting milestones from early research to modern DNS security practices. For developers and businesses, it underscores how DNS design decisions ripple through internet performance and security.
items.summary_zh: DNS 博物馆收集并展示域名系统的历史文献与展品，梳理从早期研究到现今 DNS 安全实践的关键节点。通过互动和叙述，帮助开发者和企业理解 DNS 的演进及其对互联网的影响。

items.title_en: Galois Finite Fields and the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
items.title_zh: 伽罗瓦有限域与高级加密标准（AES）
items.summary_en: A primer explains how Galois fields underpin AES operations, connecting algebraic structure to encryption strength, useful for students and practitioners.
items.summary_zh: 入门文讲解伽罗瓦有限域如何支撑 AES 运算，将代数结构与加密强度联系起来，适合学生与从业者阅读。

items.title_en: A death, a plagiarism scandal and a quest for revenge: the tale of Otto Z
items.title_zh: 死亡、抄袭丑闻与复仇之路：Otto Z 的故事
items.summary_en: A Guardian interactive delves into Otto Z's death, plagiarism allegations, and revenge arc, illustrating how digital narratives complicate accountability and memory.
items.summary_zh: 《卫报》的一篇互动报道讲述 Otto Z 的死亡、抄袭丑闻与复仇故事，揭示数字叙事如何让问责与记忆变得错综复杂。

items.title_en: I electrified my push scooter with a power drill
items.title_zh: 我用电钻把我的推式滑板车改造成电动的
items.summary_en: A DIY write-up shows how a power drill can be repurposed to drive a push scooter, detailing setup, speed, and safety caveats.
items.summary_zh: 这篇自制改装记录展示了如何用电钻驱动推式滑板车，并讲解了安装要点、速度表现与安全注意事项。

items.title_en: One parser, two bugs, many routers: Exploiting Broadcom WiFi across eCos, Linux
items.title_zh: 一个解析器，两个漏洞，众多路由器：Broadcom WiFi 漏洞覆盖 eCos 与 Linux
items.summary_en: A parser flaw in Broadcom WiFi stacks leads to two bugs that affect eCos and Linux-based routers. The write-up outlines practical exploitation paths and what firmware mitigations and vendor patches should address.
items.summary_zh: Broadcom WiFi 栈中的一个解析器缺陷导致两处漏洞，影响基于 eCos 与 Linux 的路由器。文章给出可行的利用路径，并就固件缓解措施和厂商修补提出建议。

items.title_en: SIGSALY: Churchill's top secret hotline to the president
items.title_zh: SIGSALY：丘吉尔与总统之间的绝密热线
items.summary_en: SIGSALY was a massive wartime cryptographic voice system that provided secure communications between Allied leaders. It represents an early, fully digital approach to encrypted telephony and marked a milestone in cryptography and secure data transmission.
items.summary_zh: SIGSALY 是二战时期的巨型数字化加密语音系统，为盟军领导人提供安全通信，标志着对话音 cryptography 的重要里程碑，也是早期数字化密钥传输的里程碑。

items.title_en: Types of types: Haskell's Kind system
items.title_zh: Haskell 的 Kind 系统
items.summary_en: Delves into the Haskell kind system, explaining how kinds classify type constructors and support higher-kinded types. It clarifies the role of kinds in enabling advanced type-level programming and ensuring kind-correctness in generic code.
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍 Haskell 的 Kind（类型的类型）系统，解释如何用来分类类型构造器并支撑高阶类型。通过示例，阐明 Kind 在实现高级类型级编程和保证通用代码的类型正确性中的作用。

items.title_en: How to Train Your Robot
items.title_zh: 如何训练你的机器人
items.summary_en: Modern robot learning blends simulation-based reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and sim-to-real transfer to build capable, safe systems. The piece emphasizes data efficiency, safety, and the importance of aligning hardware, perception, and planning with learning.
items.summary_zh: 现代机器人学习综合了基于仿真的强化学习、模仿学习和模拟到现实的迁移等方法，以构建高效、可安全运行的系统。文章强调数据效率、安全性，以及使感知、规划与硬件协同学习的重要性。

items.title_en: Credit where credit is due
items.title_zh: 应当让贡献者获得应得的荣誉
items.summary_en: The piece argues for giving proper credit to contributors, especially in collaborative projects and open-source ecosystems, and suggests ways to acknowledge impact fairly.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张在协作与开源生态中给予贡献者应有的认可，并提出公平致谢的具体做法。

items.title_en: The First Candid
items.title_zh: 《The First Candid》
items.summary_en: A reflective piece exploring the origins and significance of candid moments in media and memory.
items.summary_zh: 对媒体与记忆中“坦诚镜头”现象的起源与意义进行反思性考察。

items.title_en: "Traditional, but Puzzling"
items.title_zh: 传统，但充满谜题
items.summary_en: Traditional, but puzzling.
items.summary_zh: 在快速变化的现代科技环境中，传统的方法为何会显得让人困惑，本文提供简短的反思。

items.title_en: Developing for Debugging (2025)
items.title_zh: 以调试为核心的开发（2025）
items.summary_en: Developing for debugging argues for building software with debugging in mind, including DNS propagation realities, observability, and reproducible environments to reduce toil.
items.summary_zh: 《Developing for Debugging》强调在开发阶段就把调试考虑进来，包括 DNS 传播现实、可观测性和可重复的执行环境，以降低调试成本。

items.title_en: 16-bit fully functional DIY magnetic core memory
items.title_zh: 16 位全功能 DIY 磁芯存储器
items.summary_en: A 16-bit fully functional DIY magnetic core memory project demonstrates retro storage hardware in action. The hands-on build offers a tangible look at early RAM technology and why retro hardware remains appealing to makers.
items.summary_zh: 一个16位完全可用的DIY磁芯存储器项目，展示了复古存储硬件的实际工作过程。动手制作让人直观理解早期 RAM 的工作原理，以及为何复古硬件仍然吸引创客。

items.title_en: Coconuts in Medieval Britain (2015)
items.title_zh: 中世纪英国的椰子（2015）
items.summary_en: A retrospective on coconuts used as horse-hoof sound effects in Monty Python's Holy Grail, linking the gag to medieval Britain.
items.summary_zh: 回顾蒙提·派森《圣杯》中用作马蹄声的椰子，以及它与中世纪英国语境的有趣联系。文章探讨这一道具喜剧的设计理念以及为何这一梗在流行文化中持续流传。

items.title_en: How Postgres DELETE can actually scale
items.title_zh: How Postgres DELETE can actually scale
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL can scale large DELETE workloads by employing partitioning, batching deletes, and pruning through indexes. Techniques like avoiding full-table scans, using COPY-based archiving, and batching in transactions help keep latency predictable and reduce locking.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 可以通过分区、分批删除以及利用索引来处理大规模删除工作负载。通过避免全表扫描、采用归档前置操作和将删除分批提交等实践，可以在数据增长时保持吞吐和低延迟。
